props.description: An animated scatter plot builds on screen: dots populate as gray circles across fare (x) and age (y) axes. Then they color-split — steelblue for survived, salmon for not survived. The camera slowly zooms into the upper-right quadrant (high fare, mixed age) where steelblue dots dominate. A callout annotation appears: 'High fare = more survivors.' The animation turns the statistical pattern into a visual discovery moment rather than a static chart.
